title: Memorization Over Reasoning? Exposing and Mitigating Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models’ Character Understanding Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the distinction between memorization and reasoning in LLMs using character understanding tasks (personality traits, roles, and relationships).
